newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco sets 1997 capex at 6.5 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Meralco sets 1997 capex at 6.5 bln pesos.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco), the country's largest electricity distributor, has set a capital budget of 6.5 billion pesos this year compared with 5.7 billion pesos last year, company president Manuel Lopez told stockholders on Tuesday.
Lopez said the capital spending will be focused on upgrading and expanding power sub-stations as sales volumes were seen growing by 9.5 percent this year.
The firm will also build a fibre optic telecommunications network within its franchise area in the Metro Manila area which would be leased out to interested companies.
Construction of the network is expected to start in the second half and will cost 600 million pesos, Lopez said.
Company officials said the capital spending will be funded through a combination of internally-generated funds and loans.
